detailed_description: The Love Calculator turns two names into a playful compatibility percentage between 50 and 100, using a deterministic algorithm that runs entirely in your browser: both names are lowercased, their letters are combined and sorted, and the result is passed through a numeric hash, so the same pair of names always produces the same score. Names that share more letters tend to land higher. The score maps to one of five message tiers with a matching emoji, from a friendly nudge in the fifties to heart emojis at ninety and above, and the result can be retried or shared through your browser's share sheet where available. The page is entertainment only — it is not a measure of real relationships or feelings — which makes it a light game for friends, an icebreaker in chats, or a quick gag at gatherings. No names are uploaded: every calculation happens locally on your device, with no account, no server round-trip, and no stored input.
usage_steps: Type the first name into the first input field.
Type the second name into the second input field.
Click the calculate button — a short animation plays while the score is computed.
Read the compatibility percentage (always between 50 and 100) together with its message and emoji tier.
Use the retry button to clear the fields and test another pair; the same two names always return the same score.
Use the share button to send the result through your browser's share sheet where available.
usage_examples: A college student analyzing name compatibility with a potential roommate before lease signing
A game developer testing character relationship mechanics using algorithmic name pairings
A behavioral researcher conducting blind studies on name-based attraction bias
A wedding planner creating interactive name-compatibility displays for reception entertainment

faqs.question: How does the Love Calculator determine compatibility scores?
faqs.answer: The calculator processes the characters in both names using a deterministic algorithm, ensuring reproducible, consistent percentage scores for identical name pairs.

faqs.question: Is this tool intended for serious relationship or psychological advice?
faqs.answer: No. The Love Calculator is purely designed for lighthearted entertainment, party games, fiction writing, and social fun.

faqs.question: Are the names stored or transmitted to external servers?
faqs.answer: No. All name comparisons and percentage calculations execute completely in your browser without storing or uploading user inputs.
